description: Run one action listed by galon_actions, with the permissions, limits and logs of an HTTP call. Use when galon_actions lists the action and no other tool does it. Before: galon_actions (id and params). With an app connected by OAuth, a spend, destructive, public or production action needs a person: the refusal approval_required carries the request_approval to send. Returns the JSON of the action, or its named error (a missing permission is refused as over HTTP). Cost: the cost of the action it runs (its cost in galon_actions; prices: get_pricing); a paid action reserves its price on the prepaid balance first.

params.body_text: export default { fetch() { return new Response('ok') } }

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intent. Reuse it on retry.

params.description: One field per path or query parameter, named as in galon_actions; body: the JSON body. For an action whose params.raw_body lists content types (a function source, a site archive): body_text (text) or body_base64 (bytes), with content_type.

name: galon_call
title: Run a Galon API action
